verdict.rationale: Maritime advertises serverless infra by default with an 'always-on' add-on for agents that must run continuously, and a persistent Linux desktop model for end users, suggesting long-lived sessions are possible but only via a paid add-on rather than a default guarantee for hours/days-long sandbox sessions. missing for 10: explicit documentation of session/session-timeout limits, confirmation that a sandbox session can run unattended for hours or days without the always-on add-on, and independent verification of long-running task stability.
